+---
+`builtin/validators/code-hygiene/rules/missing-docs-go.md` runs `revive` with a temporary config holding only `[rule.exported]`, and declares `supersedes: [missing-docs]`.
+
+`missing-docs.md` exempts "Generated code". revive's generated-file skip is the global `ignoreGeneratedHeader` option. It defaults to FALSE, and the one-line temp config does not set it. A changed `*.pb.go` or `*_gen.go` reports "should have comment" for every exported symbol it declares, often hundreds. Setting `ignoreGeneratedHeader = true` in the temp config reproduces the exemption.
+
+Two more carve-outs are dropped: "Obvious implementations (Display, Debug, ToString, etc.)" and "Simple getters/setters with self-explanatory names". `exported` requires a doc comment on `func (e *MyErr) Error() string` and on `func (t T) String() string` alike. revive's `disableChecksOnMethods` would turn off ALL method checks, not the obvious ones, so the carve-out cannot be stated at the granularity the prompt rule uses.
+
+Two carve-outs ARE reproduced: private items, from Go capitalization; and tests, because revive's `exported` rule inherits golint's `isTest(file)` guard and skips `_test.go` files.
+
+Decide the generated-header setting, and how the obvious-implementation carve-out is stated or dropped on the record.
